business_summary: Jiading International Group Holdings Ltd, an investment holding company, provides advertising services in Hong Kong. The company was formerly known as Farnova Group Holdings Limited. Jiading International Group Holdings Ltd is headquartered in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Jiading International Group Holdings Ltd는 홍콩에서 광고 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Farnova Group Holdings Limited로 알려졌습니다. Jiading International Group Holdings Ltd는 홍콩 셩완에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
